title: API & Export
intro: Publish a saved version of this workflow as an API on this computer, or export it as a standalone FastAPI project.

overview.keys_one: {{count}} active key may call this API.
overview.keys_other: {{count}} active keys may call this API.
overview.pendingApprovals_one: {{count}} API run waits for an approval.
overview.pendingApprovals_other: {{count}} API runs wait for an approval.
overview.missing: Missing since publishing: {{names}}. Runs that need them fail.
overview.notPublished: This workflow is not published yet. Publishing freezes a saved version; later edits change nothing until you publish again.
overview.unsaved: The editor has unsaved changes. Only saved versions can be published.
overview.upToDate: Saved version {{version}} is the latest published one.
overview.willPublish: Saved version {{version}} of the workflow will be checked and frozen.
overview.slugHint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. Empty: taken from the workflow name.
overview.activateHint: Otherwise clients reach it only under /versions/{number}/runs until you activate it.
overview.switchOffText: New runs are refused with 503 until you switch it on again. Runs that already started finish unless you cancel them here.
overview.cancelRunning: Also cancel runs that are running or waiting for an approval
overview.deleteText: All published versions of it are removed; keys lose access to it. Its runs stay in the history. The workflow itself is not changed.

check.approvals_one: {{count}} approval step: runs wait there for a decision.
check.approvals_other: {{count}} approval steps: runs wait there for decisions.

versions.title: Published versions
versions.hint: Published versions never change. Make an earlier one active to roll back; runs keep the version they started with.

keys.title: API keys
keys.intro: Every request needs a key, also from this computer. Nodestro stores only a fingerprint of each key; the key itself is shown once when you create it.
keys.publishFirst: Publish a version first; keys belong to published APIs.
keys.name: Name
keys.onlyOnce: Copy the key now. Nodestro does not store it and cannot show it again.
keys.howToUse: Send it with every request as the header Authorization: Bearer <key>.
keys.rotate: Replace with a new key (the old one stops working)

network.title: Network access
network.intro: Published APIs answer only this computer. Network access opens a separate port for other devices in your network; the Nodestro interface and its internal endpoints are never reachable there.
network.shareHint: Devices in your network reach this API through the network port, with a key.
network.shareInactive: Takes effect when network access is switched on in the network settings.
network.warning: Only switch this on in a network you trust. Without a certificate, keys and data travel unencrypted. Never forward this port to the internet.
network.enableHint: Off by default and after restoring a backup.
network.hostHint: 0.0.0.0 listens on every network of this computer; enter one address to limit it.
network.tlsHint: Optional: a certificate and key file on this computer turn on HTTPS.
network.plain: Without a certificate the API answers over plain HTTP.

try.intro: Send a request exactly as a client would. Checking costs nothing; a test run is a real run of the published version and is billed like any run.
try.disabled: The API is switched off; test runs are refused like client requests.
try.bodyHint: Prefilled with an example that fits the version's input.
try.notJson: The body is not valid JSON.

docs.intro: Generated from version {{number}}. Every endpoint needs a key with the named permission.
docs.auth: Authentication: send Authorization: Bearer <key> (or X-API-Key: <key>). Errors always answer with error.code, error.message and error.params.

purposes.start: Start a run of the active version
purposes.start_version: Start a run of a specific version

curl.sync: Start and wait for the result

status.awaiting_approval: waits for a decision (Nodestro or the approve endpoint)
status.failed: ended with an error; it can be continued

settings.slugHint: Changing it changes the URL: clients have to be updated.
settings.limitsIntro: Limits protect your budget and this computer. They apply per API; requests above them get 429 with Retry-After.
settings.syncHint: Clients may wait for the result with ?wait=<seconds>. Not possible with approval steps.
settings.noBudget: Without a daily budget, clients can cause unlimited cost.

limits.runs_per_minute: New runs per minute and key

export.intro: A standalone FastAPI project with this version, the same runtime that runs it here, tests, examples and a README. Generated without AI; no keys or settings of this installation are included.
export.gitHint: The project installs Orkexa from its Git repository at the exact commit. Whoever installs it needs read access to that repository.
export.bundleHint: The source code of Orkexa (MIT license) is copied into the project, so it installs without access to the repository.
export.confirmDistribution: I may pass on the source code of Orkexa to whoever receives this project.
export.resourcesHint: Knowledge files and memory are data of this installation. They are only included if you tick them.

include.memory: Include the current content of memory {{name}}

guide.title: Integration guide with AI (optional)
guide.intro: The README is complete without AI. On request, the assistant model writes an additional guide in prose from the generated documentation; you review it before it can be included.
guide.cost: This sends the API's documentation (no keys, no data) to the assistant model and costs one request.
guide.draft: Draft by {{model}}, cost {{cost}}. Read it before accepting.

gate.title: Release gate
gate.intro: Optional: a new version is published only after its test series have tested it. Without a gate nothing changes.
gate.enableHint: Applies to every new version of this API. Versions already published stay as they are.
gate.suitesHint: The latest test run of each series must have tested exactly the version to publish, with the saved models.
gate.passRateHint: A case counts when its run succeeded and all its checks passed.
gate.judgeScoreHint: Empty: AI ratings are shown but not required.
gate.blocked: The release gate blocks this version. Mandatory checks cannot be skipped: test exactly this version.
gate.overridable: Not every result meets the gate. You can still publish if you give a reason; it is stored with the version.
gate.probabilisticHint: AI ratings can be wrong. They are kept separate from the fixed checks.
gate.reasonHint: At least {{count}} characters. Stored with the version and in the history.

items.suite_changed: test series changed since the test
items.judge_missing: no AI rating in the test run (required {{threshold}})

mcpTool.title: As an MCP tool
mcpTool.intro: MCP clients on this computer, for example an AI assistant, can call this API as a tool. Every call is an ordinary run with the client's API key: same limits, budgets, approvals and history.
mcpTool.offerHint: Takes effect only when the operator starts Nodestro with NODESTRO_MCP_SERVER=1. The client needs an API key with the permission to start runs.
mcpTool.howToUse: Enter this address in the MCP client and send the API key as a Bearer token; the tool is called {{name}}.
